calculation.description: Rank assets by the negative of their trailing five-session return divided by trailing 20-session daily return volatility. This contrarian signal gives more influence to large moves when normalized by each asset's recent risk. Inputs are lagged through the prior completed trading day.

validation.regime_notes: Validation used all 15 tradable benchmark instruments with 3,018 daily cross-sectional observations and mean 14.58 instruments per date. Full-history signal passed the benchmark gate; recent 252-day and online-period results also passed, while the small 2029 sample is encouraging but uncertain. Avoid assuming independence from existing reversal factors until deterministic library correlation is recomputed.

admission_gates.metric_basis: 10-day forward cross-sectional rank IC; paper metrics are online/recent validation used for robustness
